compiler: Xcode 27.1 (27A9275), Swift 6.4; builds target PlannerNavigation and its app/test dependencies with one job.
mobile: iOS 27.0 simulators: iPhone 18 Pro and iPad Air 11-inch (M4), compiled with iOS Simulator 27.1 SDK.
mac: macOS 27.0.1 host; native macOS build, local ad hoc signing only. Native UI runtime recorded separately.
appearance: Mobile wrapper sets light/dark, records and restores the original simulator appearance. Dark Item navigation also passes AppleInterfaceStyle as a process-scoped launch argument; the product adds no forced appearance.
